$comment: Keyboard table for each component's docs page: [keys, what it does]. Join keys pressed together with ' + '.
accordion: Opens or closes the focused item.
Opens or closes the focused item.
Moves to the next item's trigger.
Moves to the previous item's trigger.
alert-dialog: Moves between the dialog's buttons. Focus stays inside.
Does nothing: an alert dialog needs an answer.
autocomplete: Opens the list, or moves to the next suggestion.
Closes the list, or clears the field if it's already closed.
Accepts the inline completion, when there is one.
calendar: Moves a day back or forward.
Moves a week back or forward.
Moves to the start of the week.
Moves to the end of the week.
card: On an interactive card you made focusable (with `tabIndex` and a `role`), sinks the card while the key is held, unless your own `onKeyDown` calls `preventDefault()`. What the press does is yours, in `onClick` or `onKeyDown`.
carousel: Moves between the buttons and indicators.
color-picker: Moves the focused thumb a step.
Moves the area's thumb up and down a step.
Moves ten steps at a time.
Moves the slider to its start.
Moves the slider to its end.
combobox: Opens the list, or moves to the next item.
With several values, removes the last chip when the field is empty.
command: Goes back a page when the search is empty.
Clears the search, or goes back a page.
context-menu: Opens the menu on the focused area.
date-input: Moves between day, month and year.
date-picker: Moves between days in the calendar.
dialog: Moves between the dialog's controls. Focus stays inside.
drawer: Moves between the drawer's controls. Focus stays inside.
file-input: Opens the file chooser from the trigger or the dropzone.
hover-card: Opens the card when the link gets focus.
image-cropper: Moves the selection, or resizes it from a focused handle.
Moves ten pixels at a time.
input: Clears the field, when it has a clear button.
listbox: Moves between items, and selects with one choice.
Toggles the focused item with several choices.
Jumps to the next item starting with that letter.
menu: Opens the menu from its trigger, or chooses an item.
Opens a context menu on the focused area.
Jumps to the next item starting with that letter.
menubar: Moves between the bar's menus, and opens the next one if a menu is open.
motion-style: Moves to the previous or next style.
otp-input: Fills the slot and moves to the next.
Clears the slot and moves back.
password-input: Shows or hides the password, from the toggle.
popover: Opens the popover from its trigger.
Closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger.
preferences: In a preference switcher, moves to the previous or next value.
resizable: Moves ten steps at a time.
Shrinks the panel before the handle as far as it goes.
Grows it as far as it goes.
Collapses or restores a collapsible panel.
scroll-area: Scrolls, once the area has focus.
segmented-control: Selects the previous or next option.
select: Opens the list, or chooses the highlighted item.
Jumps to an item starting with that letter.
sidebar: Moves between the trigger and the items.
Opens the focused item, or folds a collapsible group from its label.
Closes the sidebar while it is a sheet on a phone, and puts focus back on the page's trigger.
slider: Moves the focused thumb a step.
Moves ten steps at a time.
table: Moves between the sort buttons, checkboxes and links in the table.
Sorts by the focused column, or turns its sort over.
Sorts by the focused column, or ticks the focused row's checkbox.
tabs: Moves to the previous or next tab.
Selects the focused tab, with manual activation.
textarea: Sends, when `submitShortcut` is `"enter"`. Shift + Enter adds a line.
timeline: Moves between events, in a feed.
toggle: Moves between toggles in a group.
token-input: Removes the token before the caret.
tooltip: Opens the tooltip when its trigger gets focus.
tree: Opens a folder, or moves into it.
Closes a folder, or moves to its parent.
Checks the focused item, when checkable.
Jumps to an item starting with that letter.
trigger-menu: Opens the menu, for each trigger character you set.
Opens the menu where the caret is.
alert: Moves focus to the dismiss button, when there is one.
Dismisses the alert from its dismiss button.
Dismisses the alert from its dismiss button.
breadcrumb: Moves between the links in the trail; the current page is skipped.
button-group: Moves to the next control in the group; each one is its own tab stop.
code-block: Moves focus to the code, then to the copy button.
Scroll the code while it has focus.
Copies the code from the copy button.
form: In a text field, submits the form. Fields are checked first and the first invalid one takes focus.
Moves between the fields and the submit button.
input-group: Moves between the field and the buttons in the group; each is its own tab stop.
item: Moves to the next row that is a link or a button; the highlight follows.
Opens the focused row's link or presses its button.
native-select: Changes the option, or moves through the open picker.
Jumps to an option starting with that letter.
trace: Moves to the next row that expands, or link.
Opens or closes the focused row.
attachment: Moves between each file’s preview and actions.
Activates the focused preview or action.
bubble: Moves to interactive bubbles and reaction controls.
Follows a focused bubble link or activates a bubble button.
Activates a bubble rendered as a button.
direction: Moves focus to the direction toggle and controls inside the boundary.
message-scroller: Moves to the scroll viewport and jump-to-latest button.
message: Moves between links, actions and other interactive content inside a message.
questionnaire: Moves through answers and navigation actions.
Moves between radio answers; moves focus between checkbox answers.
Goes back or forward outside radio and text controls, following reading direction.
Continues, or submits the last question.
Chooses an answer when matching shortcuts are enabled.
